race.title: Matchbook Signup Get 20% Back On Losses Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: LUNAR TRIX created a fine impression when scoring here last month and may prove too strong for fellow course winner Chicker . Sea Tempest and Clondaw Buster appeal most of the hurdling debutants. LUNAR TRIX (IRE) CHICKER SEA TEMPEST (IRE)
